scoring_justification: Phase stability windows recomputed from agent's enthalpy curves against paper transitions; structures audited for space group, composition, and key motifs; Tc compared to paper value.

outputs.description: Enthalpy-pressure curves for candidate CaLi₂ phases and the elemental reference states. Used to determine phase stability pressure ranges and the decomposition–recombination–decomposition sequence.
Relaxed crystal structure of the C2/c phase of CaLi₂. Verifier audits lattice parameters, space group, and key interatomic distances characteristic of the predicted structure.
Relaxed crystal structure of the P2₁/c phase of CaLi₂. Verifier audits lattice parameters, space group, and the presence of Li₂ graphene-like sheets and Li1 linear chains.
Superconducting critical temperature Tc of CaLi₂ at 45 GPa computed from the Allen-Dynes formula with μ*=0.13.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are produced by the computational workflow; the solving agent must execute the complete pipeline and write the specified artifacts. The verifier compares these artifacts against the paper's reference values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference transition pressures for phase stability (20,35,54,105 GPa) from paper Fig.2a and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig.2a and text (C2/c 35–54 GPa, P2_1/c 54–105 GPa, decomposition 20–35 and >105 GPa)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from paper reported stability intervals.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The paper explicitly states these pressure ranges; they are the main result that must be reproduced.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference superconducting critical temperature Tc at 45 GPa (~15 K) from paper Fig.4a and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig.4a and text: predicted Tc ~15 K at 45 GPa in agreement with experiment
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's central Tc claim and the hidden gold for result-level comparison.
